data.desc: YSX TECH. CO., LTD is a Cayman Islands exempted company that, through its variable interest entities in China , provides comprehensive business solutions mainly for insurance companies and brokerages in China . The Company possesses in-depth knowledge of the Chinese insurance industry accumulated from years of servicing customers, and specializes in auto insurance aftermarket value-added services, software development and information technology services, as well as other scenario-based customized services, such as products and customer development services.
